summary: The root قفو (qafaw) primarily means to follow someone's tracks or footsteps, to track them. It implies following closely behind, similar to tracing their path.
lane: 1 قَفَا أَثَرَهُ ذ and إِتْرَهُ He followed his track, or footsteps; tracked him. (S, Msb.) -b2- قَفَا فُلَانًا He followed the footsteps of such a one. (TA.) See قَصَّ أَثَرَهُ , which signifies the same, for a better explanation. See also قَفَوَتُ أَثَرَهُ .

headwords.def: قَفًا The back of the neck. (S, Msb, K.) عَيْنَاهُ فِى قَفَاهُ is said of him who is put to flight. because he looks behind him, fearing pursuit. (TA in art. انف .) And جَعَلَ أَنْفَهُ فِى قَفَاهُ : see أَنْفٌ . [Also the back of the hand: and the flat back of a knife and the like.]
